## What's new

### Listening
- **Play button in the title bar** to start listening; the player bar now slides open and closed smoothly.
- **Click a verse number to play that verse**; right-click it for the menu. Click a word to hear it.
- **Right-click any surah** in the list: Read, Listen, Download, Remove or Copy name.
- **Download status and percentages** on the player's download icon and in Settings → Audio manager.
- **Loading indicator** on slow connections, so a new reciter no longer looks frozen.
- **Favourite surahs stay offline automatically**, and are removed after a month without listening. Your own downloads are never removed.
- Smoother word-by-word sweep and glow, with no sudden jumps between words.
- Removed two reciters (Abdul Basit Mujawwad and the second Mishary Alafasy Murattal); anyone using them is moved to another reciter.

### Reading
- **Two-page spread reads right to left**, like an Arabic book (page 2 on the right, page 3 on its left).
- **Mouse side buttons** go back and forward.
- **Page turns, sidebar, Settings and long surahs** open much more smoothly.
- Settings no longer shows the surah list; searchable translation picker.

### App
- **In-app updates** (Settings → Updates).
- New icon, shaped as a rounded square and larger on the taskbar.
- The interface uses the **Inter** font, bundled with the app.
- Focus mode is switched off for now.
